line_items.reasoning: Gross margin declined 70 bps to 44.8%, significantly worse than the guided 'less than ~30 bps' seasonal decline, driven by product/customer mix, higher container costs, and expedited shipments.
No specific Q4 CapEx figure was reported in the current results to contradict the full-year $235M–$255M guidance trending toward the low end, so this is treated as inline by default.

Rather than 'no meaningful change,' underlying business activity weakened noticeably — daily sales growth was only 2.1%, PMI stayed sub-50%, and holiday shutdowns hit 35% of vending-equipped facilities vs. 30% the prior year, signaling deeper industrial softness than guided.
FAST accelerated ~$10M of incremental fastener inventory ahead of potential tariffs, meeting or slightly exceeding the guided $5M–$10M incremental Q4 build on top of Q3's ~$25M addition.
